Vicar of Hursley

CMY calls him Jimmy Young.

Brother of the Rev.

Peter Young, he succeeded Keble as Vicar of Hursley, 1866; he had a wife Anna (b.

Ilfracombe 1824/5), and children Frances (b.

Brigstock Northants 1850/1), Elspeth Jane (b. 1853/4), Harry Gavin (b.

Scotland 1854/5), Anna Edith (b. 1856/7), Louisa Caroline (b. 1858/9) and Marion Jemima (b. 1859/60). [1861, 81 census, Recollections of the Rev.

Peter Young]
